connector.name: System R Risk Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Pre-trade risk validation and position sizing for AI trading agents via G-formula and Iron Fist.
connector.summary: Hosted at agents.systemr.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package systemr. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the system-r-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
